name: AutomationDirect P1-01AC controller power module
aliases: AutomationDirect P1-01AC controller power module GA
summary: P1-01AC controller power module arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: P1-01AC is the drawing identifier for controller power module in AutomationDirect's Productivity1000 PAC collection. A controller power module supplies the selected control system. Its role in that system does not establish a general-purpose supply rating for other equipment.

For example, in a machine cabinet with a dedicated supply for its controller assembly, use the P1-01AC reference to coordinate supply terminals, protective-earth route and adjacent controller modules. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as PLC Families/P1000/P1-01AC.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep supply terminals, protective-earth route and adjacent controller modules visible in the layout.
